(c) Injured $2607/50739 = 0.051$; not injured $48132/50739 = 0.949.$ (d) Observed count $= 373$; expected count $= 6617 \times 2607/50739 = 340.0$; contribution $= (373 - 340)^2/340 = 3.21.$ (e) $df = 4$; p-value $= 0.0003.$ (f) Reject $H_0$ — convincing evidence that training volume and overuse injury are associated.
